propositions: Write-op parameter surfaces across three adapters (lib, CLI, MCP) are hand-mirrored with no mechanical guard against drift; gaps like missing reason/caused_by/force on MCP are caught only by chance or LLM review.

A durable pytest conformance oracle using a single transport-agnostic contract table must mechanically verify behavioral parity: each row (op, inputs, expected accept/reject, expected effect) is executed through all three adapters and any divergence fails the suite.

The contract must cover the sanctioned surface (force as str|None reason-carrier, reason, caused_by, ref, close_class) excluding legacy force_close, and must assert runtime conditional rules (close_class-required, reason-required) behaviorally across all adapters.

Transition coupled-force rows and current MCP gaps must be encoded as strict-xfail citing their respective sibling tickets (blusterous-earthly-kitten and scratchy-leprous-galago), keeping the suite green in CI and forcing un-xfail when the referenced tickets land.

The oracle reuses and extends the existing tests/interfaces/adapters.py three-adapter harness (Outcome, Adapter protocol, Library/Cli/Mcp implementations) to thread write-op inputs through each transport, with no fresh parallel drivers.

Adapter-bound internals (source, return_alias, _creation_channel, repo_root) must not register as false divergences; a negative-control row and a simulated-parity fixture verify the oracle detects and requires cleanup of resolved xfail markers.
